or फूत्, ind. an onomat. word (used only with √ ˚कृ, and its derivatives; sometimes expressive of contempt).
फुत्—कर m. ‘making a crackling noise’, fire, L.
फुत्—कार m. puffing, blowing, hissing, the hiss of a serpent (also फूत्-क्˚), Kathās.; Kuval.
फुत्—कर्तु-मनस् mfn. wishing to make a derisory noise, intending to cry aloud, MW.
फुत्—कार—रन्ध्र n. the hole to which the mouth is applied in playing a flute, Saṃgīt.
फुत्—कार्य mfn. in अ-फूत्-क्˚, requiring no blowing, Kathās.
फुत्—कृत n. the sound of a wind instrument, L.
फुत्—कृति f. the blowing of a wind instrument, Saṃgīt.
